service_guidance.standard_application: Register and pay through eHomeAffairs, approve payment through the FNB App or online banking, then book the branch appointment.
service_guidance.appointment: Smart ID and passport application/renewal visits require a date and time booked through eHomeAffairs.
service_guidance.payment: Application payments are approved through the FNB App or online banking, not cash or in-branch debit/credit card payment.
service_guidance.fnb_account: FNB's qualifying criteria require an active, funded FNB transactional account. Check the operator's criteria for the application.
service_guidance.collection: Wait for an SMS before collecting the document; FNB asks for original identity documents at collection.
service_guidance.documents: FNB asks for original identity documents for the standard application. Its replacement guidance contains conflicting document statements; confirm the requirements for your service.
service_guidance.replacement_scope: FNB describes Smart ID replacement without an appointment at selected branches, but this section does not identify Grove individually. Confirm branch eligibility; do not assume walk-in access for passport/new-ID applications.
service_guidance.hours: FNB says participating branches can be visited Monday-Saturday during branch operating hours. Exact Grove counter times and holiday changes are not given.
service_guidance.fees: Refer to the Department of Home Affairs tariff page linked through its website; no fee amount stored.
service_guidance.eHomeAffairs_help: 0800 60 11 90 (Department of Home Affairs call centre, not the Grove counter)

hours_status: Exact weekly counter times not published; no opening rows inferred
source_conflicts: Smart ID replacement text asks for original identity documents, while an icon caption says no documentation needed. Do not resolve by guessing.
Replacement walk-in section says selected branches, but does not list Grove separately.
